Axiom Form Protection or the admin REST route, with confirmation. * - Keys live in the site configuration file: AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY (public) and AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SECRET (server only; never * output, stored or logged). Without keys the widget isn't shown and nothing is ever blocked. * - Cloudflare unreachable or misconfigured: fail open (submission accepted, result logged). * - Logs hold no names, emails, phones, tokens or raw IPs (IP and identity counters use salted hashes). * Rollback: unpublish this snippet; the form behaves exactly as before. */ namespace AngieSnippets\AxiomFormProtection; if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; } const FORM_PAGE = 1095; // contact-form-id posted by the Get Started form. const OPT = 'axiom_form_protection'; const LOG_OPT = 'axiom_form_protection_log'; const META = '_axiom_form_protection'; const VERIFY_URL = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify'; const API_JS = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js'; const ACTION = 'get-started'; const IP_LIMIT = 10; // submissions per IP per IP_WINDOW (high: offices and mobile carriers share IPs). const IP_WINDOW = 600; const ID_LIMIT = 3; // submissions per email or phone per ID_WINDOW. const ID_WINDOW = 3600; const LOG_MAX = 200; const ALERT_TO = 'axiom.systems.co@gmail.com'; const MESSAGE = 'Please confirm you are not a robot and try again. You can also call us at (727) 591-7527.'; function site_key() { return defined( 'AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY' ) ? trim( (string) AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY ) : ''; } function secret() { return defined( 'AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SECRET' ) ? trim( (string) AXIOM_TURNSTILE_SECRET ) : ''; } function configured() { return '' !== site_key() && '' !== secret(); } function mode() { $s = get_option( OPT, array() ); return is_array( $s ) && isset( $s['mode'] ) && 'enforce' === $s['mode'] && configured() ? 'enforce' : 'log'; } /* ------------------------------------------------------------ widget */ function script() { // Single-use tokens: after a failed submission, get a fresh token so the visitor can retry. return '' . ''; } function add_widget( $content ) { if ( ! is_string( $content ) || '' === site_key() || false !== strpos( $content, 'axfp-turnstile' ) ) { return $content; } $form = strpos( $content, 'class="axgs"' ); if ( false === $form ) { return $content; } $pos = strpos( $content, '
'; return substr_replace( $content, $widget, $pos, 0 ) . script(); } // After snippet 1099 has rendered the form (priority 20 / 999). add_filter( 'elementor/frontend/the_content', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\add_widget', 25 ); add_filter( 'the_content', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\add_widget', 1000 ); /* ------------------------------------------------------------ checks */ function is_our_form() { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing -- read-only check inside Jetpack's own (JWT-signed) submission. return isset( $_POST['contact-form-id'] ) && FORM_PAGE === (int) $_POST['contact-form-id']; } function client_ip() { // Same source Jetpack uses for the entry's IP. return isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ) : ''; } function hash_value( $v ) { return hash_hmac( 'sha256', (string) $v, wp_salt( 'nonce' ) ); } /** Verifies the token with Cloudflare (server-side, single call). Never logs the token or secret. */ function turnstile( $token ) { if ( '' === secret() ) { return array( 'result' => 'not-configured', 'codes' => array() ); } if ( '' === $token ) { return array( 'result' => 'missing', 'codes' => array() ); } $resp = wp_remote_post( VERIFY_URL, array( 'timeout' => 5, 'body' => array( 'secret' => secret(), 'response' => $token, 'idempotency_key' => wp_generate_uuid4(), ), ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $resp ) ) { return array( 'result' => 'unavailable', 'codes' => array( 'connection-error' ) ); } $code = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $resp ); $json = json_decode( (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $resp ), true ); if ( $code >= 500 || ! is_array( $json ) ) { return array( 'result' => 'unavailable', 'codes' => array( 'http-' . $code ) ); } $codes = isset( $json['error-codes'] ) && is_array( $json['error-codes'] ) ? array_values( array_map( 'sanitize_key', $json['error-codes'] ) ) : array(); if ( ! empty( $json['success'] ) ) { $host = strtolower( (string) wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST ) ); if ( ! empty( $json['hostname'] ) && strtolower( (string) $json['hostname'] ) !== $host ) { return array( 'result' => 'invalid', 'codes' => array( 'hostname-mismatch' ) ); } if ( ! empty( $json['action'] ) && ACTION !== $json['action'] ) { return array( 'result' => 'invalid', 'codes' => array( 'action-mismatch' ) ); } return array( 'result' => 'pass', 'codes' => array() ); } // Our own configuration or Cloudflare problems must never block real visitors. if ( array_intersect( $codes, array( 'missing-input-secret', 'invalid-input-secret', 'internal-error', 'bad-request' ) ) ) { return array( 'result' => 'unavailable', 'codes' => $codes ); } return array( 'result' => 'invalid', 'codes' => $codes ? $codes : array( 'not-successful' ) ); } /** Fixed-window counter in a transient. */ function bump( $key, $window ) { $now = time(); $v = get_transient( $key ); if ( ! is_array( $v ) || (int) $v[1] + $window <= $now ) { $v = array( 0, $now ); } $v[0] = (int) $v[0] + 1; set_transient( $key, $v, max( 1, (int) $v[1] + $window - $now ) ); return $v[0]; } /** Hashed email and phone of this submission (field names end in -email / -phone). */ function identities() { $ids = array(); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing foreach ( (array) $_POST as $name => $value ) { if ( ! is_string( $value ) || ! is_string( $name ) ) { continue; } if ( preg_match( '/-email$/', $name ) && '' !== trim( $value ) ) { $ids[] = 'e' . hash_value( strtolower( trim( wp_unslash( $value ) ) ) ); } elseif ( preg_match( '/-phone$/', $name ) ) { $digits = substr( preg_replace( '/\D+/', '', $value ), -10 ); if ( strlen( $digits ) >= 7 ) { $ids[] = 'p' . hash_value( $digits ); } } } return $ids; } function decide( $r ) { if ( in_array( $r['turnstile'], array( 'missing', 'invalid' ), true ) ) { $d = 'reject'; } elseif ( $r['rate_limited'] ) { $d = 'flag-spam'; } elseif ( 'pass' === $r['turnstile'] ) { $d = 'allow'; } else { $d = 'allow-fail-open'; } return ( 'enforce' === $r['mode'] || 0 === strpos( $d, 'allow' ) ) ? $d : 'would-' . $d; } function evaluate() { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing $token = isset( $_POST['cf-turnstile-response'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['cf-turnstile-response'] ) ) : ''; $ip = client_ip(); $ts = turnstile( $token ); $ipn = '' !== $ip ? bump( 'axfp_i' . substr( hash_value( $ip ), 0, 32 ), IP_WINDOW ) : 0; $idn = 0; foreach ( identities() as $id ) { $idn = max( $idn, bump( 'axfp_' . substr( $id, 0, 33 ), ID_WINDOW ) ); } // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing $fill = isset( $_POST['jetpack_form_fill_duration'] ) && '' !== $_POST['jetpack_form_fill_duration'] ? (int) $_POST['jetpack_form_fill_duration'] : null; $r = array( 'time' => time(), 'mode' => mode(), 'turnstile' => $ts['result'], 'codes' => $ts['codes'], 'ip_count' => $ipn, 'id_count' => $idn, 'rate_limited' => $ipn > IP_LIMIT || $idn > ID_LIMIT, 'fill_seconds' => $fill, 'ip_ref' => '' !== $ip ? substr( hash_value( $ip ), 0, 8 ) : '', ); $r['decision'] = decide( $r ); return $r; } function log_event( $r ) { $log = get_option( LOG_OPT, array() ); $log = is_array( $log ) ? $log : array(); $log[] = $r; update_option( LOG_OPT, array_slice( $log, -LOG_MAX ), false ); } function last( $set = null ) { static $r = null; if ( null !== $set ) { $r = $set; } return $r; } function check( $is_spam, $form = array() ) { if ( true === $is_spam || is_wp_error( $is_spam ) || ! is_our_form() ) { return $is_spam; } try { $r = evaluate(); last( $r ); if ( 'reject' === $r['decision'] ) { $r['entry'] = null; log_event( $r ); return new \WP_Error( 'axiom_form_protection', MESSAGE ); } if ( 'flag-spam' === $r['decision'] ) { return true; } } catch ( \Throwable $e ) { unset( $e ); // Never break the form. } return $is_spam; } // Before Jetpack's blocklist and Akismet checks (priority 10). add_filter( 'jetpack_contact_form_is_spam', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\check', 5, 2 ); // Attach the result to the saved entry (runs before the GHL sync hook at priority 20). add_action( 'grunion_after_feedback_post_inserted', function ( $post_id ) { try { $r = last(); if ( is_array( $r ) ) { $r['entry'] = (int) $post_id; update_post_meta( (int) $post_id, META, $r ); log_event( $r ); last( false ); if ( 'flag-spam' === $r['decision'] ) { // A real customer must never be lost silently: the entry is kept under Feedback > Spam. wp_mail( ALERT_TO, 'Get Started entry held by rate limiting', 'Entry #' . (int) $post_id . " was saved as spam because of the submission rate limit.\n" . "If it is a real customer, open Feedback > Spam and mark it as not spam.\n" . admin_url( 'edit.php?post_type=feedback&post_status=spam' ) . "\n" ); } } } catch ( \Throwable $e ) { unset( $e ); } }, 5, 1 ); /* ------------------------------------------------------------ admin status (no secrets) */ function status() { $log = get_option( LOG_OPT, array() ); $log = is_array( $log ) ? $log : array(); $since = time() - 7 * DAY_IN_SECONDS; $counts = array(); foreach ( $log as $e ) { if ( isset( $e['time'] ) && $e['time'] >= $since ) { $k = $e['turnstile'] . ' / ' . $e['decision']; $counts[ $k ] = isset( $counts[ $k ] ) ? $counts[ $k ] + 1 : 1; } } return array( 'mode' => mode(), 'site_key_set' => '' !== site_key(), 'secret_set' => '' !== secret(), 'limits' => array( 'ip' => IP_LIMIT . ' per ' . IP_WINDOW . 's', 'email_or_phone' => ID_LIMIT . ' per ' . ID_WINDOW . 's' ), 'last_7_days' => $counts, 'recent' => array_slice( array_reverse( $log ), 0, 50 ), // Diagnostic for the person viewing: is REMOTE_ADDR the visitor (same as Cloudflare's header)? 'your_request_ip' => array( 'remote_addr_set' => '' !== client_ip(), 'cf_connecting_ip_set' => isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP'] ), 'remote_addr_equals_cf' => isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP'] ) && client_ip() === sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_SERVER['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP'] ) ), 'x_forwarded_for_set' => isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ), ), ); } function set_mode( $mode, $confirmed ) { if ( 'enforce' === $mode && ( ! $confirmed || ! configured() ) ) { return new \WP_Error( 'axiom_mode', 'Enforcement needs both Turnstile keys and explicit confirmation.', array( 'status' => 400 ) ); } if ( ! in_array( $mode, array( 'log', 'enforce' ), true ) ) { return new \WP_Error( 'axiom_mode', 'Mode must be log or enforce.', array( 'status' => 400 ) ); } update_option( OPT, array( 'mode' => $mode, 'changed' => time(), 'by' => get_current_user_id() ), false ); return status(); } add_action( 'rest_api_init', function () { register_rest_route( 'axiom/v1', '/form-protection', array( array( 'methods' => 'GET', 'permission_callback' => function () { return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ); }, 'callback' => function () { $r = rest_ensure_response( status() ); $r->header( 'Cache-Control', 'no-store' ); return $r; }, ), array( 'methods' => 'POST', 'permission_callback' => function () { return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ); }, 'callback' => function ( $request ) { return rest_ensure_response( set_mode( (string) $request['mode'], 'enforcement-approved' === $request['confirm'] ) ); }, ), ) ); } ); add_action( 'admin_menu', function () { add_management_page( 'Axiom Form Protection', 'Axiom Form Protection', 'manage_options', 'axiom-form-protection', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\admin_page' ); } ); function admin_page() { if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) { return; } $notice = ''; if ( isset( $_POST['axfp_mode'] ) && check_admin_referer( 'axfp_mode' ) ) { $r = set_mode( sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_POST['axfp_mode'] ) ), ! empty( $_POST['axfp_confirm'] ) ); $notice = is_wp_error( $r ) ? $r->get_error_message() : 'Mode saved.'; } $s = status(); echo '

Axiom Form Protection

'; if ( $notice ) { echo '

' . esc_html( $notice ) . '

'; } echo '

Mode: ' . esc_html( $s['mode'] ) . ' · Site key: ' . ( $s['site_key_set'] ? 'set' : 'missing' ) . ' · Secret: ' . ( $s['secret_set'] ? 'set' : 'missing' ) . '

'; echo '
'; wp_nonce_field( 'axfp_mode' ); echo ' '; echo '
'; echo '

Last 7 days

' . esc_html( wp_json_encode( $s['last_7_days'], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) ) . '
'; echo '

Recent submissions

' . esc_html( wp_json_encode( $s['recent'], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) ) . '
'; }
